page.overview:
Who is Blue Mary?

Blue Mary is very friendly towards everyone, but she knows (or thinks) that her job must come first before everything else. She also can fuel her attacks and throws with ki and is capable of throwing any opponent, no matter their weight.

According to Neo Geo Freak, she is modeled after Dragon Balls Android 18.

Blue Mary can be seen at the Pao Pao Cafe seated at a table. In World Tour, she appears in Beat Square and travels to the cafe when she and Joe learn of people dressed as them, thinking they are impostors. The player character can also learn one of her moves, Vertical Arrow, if they find her lost dog Anton.
